newsitem.title: EGYPT: Cairo house caves in on residents, injures four.
newsitem.headline: Cairo house caves in on residents, injures four.

text.p: Four people were injured and a woman feared dead when a four-storey building caved in on top of its residents in a populous and poor Cairo district on Tuesday.
Rescue workers said they had pulled the four injured from the rubble in Haret Sidi Maaz in the Islamic Azhar district of the capital and were trying to find Sayyeda Masoud who is still trapped.
"She's probably dead but we can't be sure until we have a body," a fireman told Reuters as her son, Kamal, screamed and wailed.

The top two floors of the building collapsed at about 7 p.m. local time (1700 gmt), trapping the few residents who were still inside their homes. Most of the building's 50 residents had left earlier after a piece of masonry fell.

District engineer Ashraf Abdallah said the building had been condemned three months ago and officials had told the residents to leave or fix the building's foundation but residents said they had not been informed in time.
"They told us only today that the two floors had to go," said Sana'a Ismail. "And now the house is gone and we have nowhere to go."
